say:0:1720943501:1.text: Viscount Demit is the one really running the Savannah Eye, and someone has been secretly bankrolling him.

say:1:1720943502:1.text: And he uses that money to keep the paper afloat. Then he has free copies distributed through taverns and other busy spots until the whole capital is reading it.

say:2:1720943503:1.text: We still don't know who's funding him, or what they want out of it. But no one burns this much money on a free paper unless they're trying to gain something bigger than profit.
